Handmade in Turkey, this Andelz runner draws inspiration from classic Persian Zanjan and Hamadan village designs, blending intricate corner medallions with a rich sense of heritage.


  • • Red base with black, cream, dark brown, grey, and salmon accents


  • • Medallion corners pattern with detailed floral and geometric motifs


  • • Hand-knotted from 100% wool for lasting quality


  • • Low pile height offers versatility and structure


  • • Semi-antique with authentic quirks and variations that reflect its handmade origin

Like most things, our rugs require regular maintenance in order to last as long as possible. This includes periodic vacuuming and rotation. If spills occur, blot immediately. Use common wool cleaning detergent to remove stains. For extreme spills and stains, we recommend professional cleaning. For more information, read our After Care.
